articles.title: Kalshi Scores FIFA World Cup Spotlight as Prediction Market Trading Surges to Record
articles.snippet: As prediction markets notch record trading volumes, Kalshi is ramping up its marketing push through a high-profile FIFA World Cup deal.

articles.title: Anthropic Urges Congress to Crack Down on AI Distillation By Chinese Rivals
articles.snippet: Anthropic alleged that Alibaba-affiliated operators used nearly 25,000 fraudulent accounts to generate 28.8 million Claude exchanges.

articles.title: Polymarket to Refund Users After Scammers Swipe Millions in Website Exploit
articles.snippet: Hackers infiltrated Polymarket’s website via a compromised third-party vendor, the company said, swiping millions in crypto from users.
